ORDER OF ADJOURNMENT

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY COUNCIL
  Regular Meeting
  October 27, 2025
  6:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL

The Alhambra City Council met in the Council Chambers of the Alhambra City Hall commencing at 6:36 p.m.
on MONDAY, October 27, 2025. Council Members present: MAZA, MALONEY, WANG, ANDRADE-
STADLER, LEE. Council Members absent: NONE. City Officials present: City Manager Binnquist, City
Attorney Montes, City Clerk Myles, Assistant City Manager Garcia, Deputy City Manager Hembree, Director of
Finance Lieu, Chief of Police Kennedy, Director of Parks & Recreation Macias, Director of Public Works and
Utilities Ahlen, Fire Chief Ragusa, Library Director LohGuan, Director of Human Resources and Risk
Management Ko, Director of Community Development Ho, Management Analyst Alvarez, Planning Manager
McCurley

ADJOURN TO 12-8-25 at 5:00 p.m. – N2M25-158

At 9:32 p.m., there being no further business for the Council to transact, with the unanimous consent of the
City Council, the Mayor:

1)  ADJOURNED this evening’s meeting to 5:00 p.m., on Monday, December 8, 2025, in the Council
  Chambers of the Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street, Alhambra, California.

  LAUREN MYLES, CMC
  CITY CLERK

Dated: October 28, 2025
Notice No. N2M25-158
